_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Tracking Report for Equipment Modification
summary: Provides an instrument for the Government to track implementation of an Engineering Change Proposal/Material Change/Modification Work Order and to track contractor's modification of government equipment.
description_purpose:
3.1 The purpose of this report is to provide an instrument for the Government to track implementation of an Engineering Change Proposal/Material Change/Modification Work Order (ECP/MC/MWO).
3.2 This report will permit the Government to track contractor's modification of government equipment.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

7.2 This DID is applicable for a periodic report of the progress on an ECP/MC/MWO action involving the field retrofit of government equipment.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

children.title: Cover Sheet.
children.content: Each report shall have a cover sheet with identifying nomenclature and title centered on the sheet along with the ECP and MC or MWO titles and numbers. Also center Major Assembly affected.

children.title: Each page of the report
children.content: shall be page numbered in the upper right hand corner.

children.title: Each page of the report
children.content: shall contain the ECP number and the MC or MWO number in the upper right hand corner.

children.title: The first page of the report
children.content: shall contain the month, day and year for the report and on a second line the estimated completion date of the ECP and the MC or MWO.

children.title: Purpose of the Modification.
children.content: Describe what capability is added, deleted, changed or what deficiency is corrected.

children.title: Problem Areas Encountered.
children.content: Describe any problem areas encountered during the application of the modification and any additional required actions.

children.title: Tabulation of Retrofit Actions.
children.content:
List all sites making the modification along with the following data in tabular format for each site:
a. Site Identification.
b. Serial Number of Items Modified.
c. Number of Items to be Modified.
d. Number of Items Modified This Period.
e. Number of Items Remaining Unmodified.

children.title: Total Tabulation.
children.content: Total all the items to be modified under this ECP/MC/MWO, total all items modified this period, and total all items remaining to be modified.
